artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a visible 'iStockphoto' watermark. While this is likely a real stock photo artifact rather than an AI generation error, in the context of 'AI-generated image evaluation', watermarks are often considered artifacts if they are nonsensical or poorly integrated. Here it is legible, so severity is low (barely noticeable as an 'error', more of a metadata artifact). However, strictly speaking, it is text present in the image.

Upon very close inspection, the transition between the red thread and the white leather is extremely sharp, lacking the minute fiber bleeding or shadow depth one might expect in a macro photo. It looks slightly 'painted on' or vector-like, which is a subtle sign of AI generation or heavy post-processing. Severity is very low as it requires pixel-peeping.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'iStockphoto' watermark. If it is perfectly rendered, it suggests this might be a real stock photo used as a test case, or a very advanced AI model trained on watermarked data. If the text is garbled, it's a clear AI artifact. Also, scrutinize the stitching: AI often fails to maintain the consistent 'double stitch' pattern, merging threads or changing direction illogically. Check if the red thread has volume (shadows) or looks flat.
